facts.P1_fx_receipts: Exchange controls apply; exporters convert 25%, freelancer treatment unconfirmed.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Foreign-currency accounts (FCDAs) exist; individual eligibility not confirmed.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register a sole proprietorship online via MBRS; fees not confirmed.
facts.L2_tax_id: TPIN from the Malawi Revenue Authority.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Malawi-source income taxed, up to 35%; work done in Malawi likely counts.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 17.5% VAT above MWK 50 million a year since April 2026.
facts.L5_data_protection: Data Protection Act 2024; only large processors (10,000+ people) must register.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can withdraw from online contracts within seven days.

watch_out.text: Older guides say MWK 25m; the VAT threshold is MWK 50m since April 2026.
